purpose: Register a validation-only paired screen for a per-channel sparse forecast support mask over one shared train-only ACF lag bank.
research_question: Does retaining each channel's strongest two legal shared-bank lag slots improve or preserve MambaACFAutoCon forecasting relative to the same dense bank, without adding learned cross-channel capacity?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory H96 screen on ETTh1 and traffic with three seeds per arm. It is candidate-selection evidence only, not confirmatory or publication evidence.
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive scaled-MSE deltas, seed dispersion, ACF-support diagnostics, and separately measured resource metadata may be reported after a new approved launch. No universal Mamba, ACF, speed, or representation-learning claim is permitted. This strict representation-causality draft is currently blocked because AutoCon_wnorm=LastVal reads the full input window.

execution.blocked_reason: Current MambaACF LastVal/Mean/ReVIN normalization reads the complete input window, so strict representation causality fails with window_full_normalization_forbidden.
required_before_launch: implement and test a prefix-causal MambaACF normalization, or obtain human approval to rewrite this strict research question before changing the strict flag

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, lag-bank arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh output root and retain the runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, complete ACF prior, compact prior, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: channel_lag_bank_off_h96
phases.purpose: Reference using the same resolved train-peaks-available lag bank with all resolved slots available to every channel.

phases.name: channel_lag_bank_on_h96
phases.purpose: The same model and resolved train-peaks-available bank with a detached top-2 legal support mask fitted independently for each channel.

planned_contrasts: channel_lag_bank_on_h96 minus channel_lag_bank_off_h96 under identical model, resolved train-peaks-available bank, raw static prior, and AutoCon relation settings
comparison_contract.resource_reference: new resource benchmark required; the lag-bank flag and top-k are part of the architecture signature
stopping_rules: Do not expand to additional datasets or horizons until all 12 jobs finish and paired seed manifests are complete.
Do not promote the sparse arm if pooled paired validation MSE worsens by more than 1 percent or if either dataset worsens on all three seeds.
Treat a favorable result with large support-density or seed heterogeneity as exploratory and repeat only after human review.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen can assess whether channel-specific ACF support is a useful low-capacity forecast-memory refinement; it cannot establish a general accuracy, speed, or representation-learning claim.
